# Aavya Boutique — Contemporary Women's Fashion, Kochi

> Aavya Boutique is a premier contemporary women's fashion house and designer ethnic wear studio based in Kochi, Kerala. Curated for the modern Indian woman, Aavya blends classic Indian craftsmanship with clean modern silhouettes. Delivering across all states in India with personal styling and fast WhatsApp ordering.

## About the Brand
- **Brand Name**: Aavya Boutique
- **Location**: Kochi, Kerala, India
- **Deliveries**: Pan-India delivery with complimentary shipping
- **Official Website**: https://aavyaboutique.in
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/aavyaboutique.in (@aavyaboutique.in)
- **WhatsApp Support & Orders**: +91 97785 24133 (https://wa.me/919778524133)

## Signature Collections
- **Designer Kurtis & Tunics**: Artisanal hand-block printed kurtis, embroidered A-line kurtas, straight cuts, and festive anarkalis crafted from pure cotton, chanderi, and mulmul.
- **Contemporary Dresses**: Satin draped midi dresses, tier dresses, organic linen silhouettes, and romantic evening wear tailored with modern flair.
- **Handcrafted Co-ord Sets**: Minimalist monochrome sets, sage linen coordinates, editorial burgundy sets, and printed resort-wear twin sets.
- **Festive & Fusion Wear**: Pre-draped festive ensembles, celebratory tunics, teal anarkalis, and refined occasion wear for weddings, celebrations, and festive gatherings.

## How to Order & WhatsApp Checkout
1. Browse products on the website: https://aavyaboutique.in
2. Add your favorite items and sizes to the shopping bag.
3. Click "Checkout via WhatsApp" — all chosen items, quantities, sizes, and subtotal will automatically pre-fill into a direct WhatsApp message to +91 97785 24133.
4. The boutique team confirms sizing, customizations, and provides instant payment options (UPI, Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking).

## Quality & Craftsmanship Promise
- Breathable, high-grade natural fabrics: Handloom Cotton, Pure Linen, Mulmul, Chanderi, Georgette, and Lustrous Satin.
- Tailored for flattering comfort, everyday elegance, and celebration-ready sophistication.
- Ethically curated in Kerala, celebrating Indian heritage textiles and modern tailoring.
